production_ratchet.production_growth_justification: The r18 assembly at 4a8135b027b7303c0381ad78b948c99dec385327 measures 364547 handwritten production LF physical lines with the existing source inventory, 1925 above the unchanged 362622-line ratchet at e504ff12b21fe6784c44470482f6feafdad774e0. The squash-6 base d6b062825849efd942d7c3836e461ec8a9f592d6 measures 363840 lines (1218 above that ratchet); the ordered FIFO snapshot, OSC 7501 variant B, source-file cancellation, SIXEL capability (#259), command completion and resize (#261), and conditional atomic portability (#254) integrations add 707 production lines in total. The earlier documented r18 count of 363743 is not the squash-6 measurement. This records physical growth, with no reduction credit or reclassification of production as tests. All production files remain below 600 lines.
production_ratchet.production_growth_decision: On 2026-11-27, the r18 assembly mandate authorizes reconciling the production budget and its justification to the exact combined source measurement. The envelope is 1925 lines, with no spare allowance; the ratchet remains 362622 and target G = 301947 remains not met and deferred to 0.12.
